articles.event_key: 网络研究者|证明|完美韧性网络理论
articles.title: Quanta报道完美韧性网络理论进展：四类结构导致路由环路
articles.summary: Quanta Magazine报道称，计算机科学家确定了导致通信网络在链路故障时循环路由的四类简单结构，并用图论minor和Robertson-Seymour定理描述“完美韧性”。
articles.new_facts: Quanta Magazine于11月20日报道，四类简单网络结构会导致通信网络在链路故障时出现循环路由；报道用图论minor和Robertson-Seymour定理说明完美韧性的结构性质。
entities: 完美韧性网络理论（perfect resilience）
articles.limitations: Quanta文章为科普采编，未给出四类结构名称及原始论文出处；定理的完整表述和同行评审状态无法由现有材料确认。

facts.text: Quanta Magazine 11月20日报道，计算机科学家确定了四类简单网络结构；通信链路故障时，消息会在这些结构中陷入循环路由。报道称，这补全了“完美韧性”网络理论。

evidence.quote: Computer scientists now know that four simple network structures are to blame.
When links in a communication network go down, messages can get routed in a loop.

facts.text: 报道用图论解释：网络可看作节点与边构成的图，通过删节点、删边或合并相邻节点得到“minor”；若原图具有完美韧性，其所有minor也具有完美韧性。结合Robertson-Seymour定理，非完美韧性的minor只有有限多个。

evidence.quote: The graphs that you can obtain by combining these operations are known as the minors of the larger graph.
If a graph is perfectly resilient, then so are all of its minors.
there’s only a finite number of minors that are not perfectly resilient

bilingual.title_en: Quanta Reports Progress on Perfect Resilience Network Theory: Four Structures Cause Routing Loops

sentences.en: Quanta Magazine reported on November 20 that computer scientists had identified four types of simple network structures, in which messages become trapped in routing loops when communication links fail.
sentences.zh: Quanta Magazine 11月20日报道，计算机科学家确定了四类简单网络结构；通信链路故障时，消息会在这些结构中陷入循环路由。

sentences.en: The report said that this completes the “perfect resilience” network theory.
sentences.zh: 报道称，这补全了“完美韧性”网络理论。

sentences.en: The report explained using graph theory that a network can be regarded as a graph made up of nodes and edges, and that a “minor” is obtained by deleting nodes, deleting edges, or merging adjacent nodes; if the original graph has perfect resilience, all its minors also have perfect resilience.
sentences.zh: 报道用图论解释：网络可看作节点与边构成的图，通过删节点、删边或合并相邻节点得到“minor”；若原图具有完美韧性，其所有minor也具有完美韧性。

sentences.en: Combined with the Robertson-Seymour theorem, this means that there are only finitely many minors that do not have perfect resilience.
sentences.zh: 结合Robertson-Seymour定理，非完美韧性的minor只有有限多个。

articles.event_key: 创伤|留下|细胞分子疤痕
articles.title: 《自然》新闻：PTSD患者脑组织出现特定DNA甲基化差异
articles.summary: 《自然》新闻11月24日报道，一项Cell Reports研究分析300余名死者脑组织，发现PTSD患者前额叶皮层四个DNA区域甲基化模式不同，杏仁核寡突胶质细胞减少，后者与成年创伤暴露相关。
articles.new_facts: Cell Reports论文比较101名PTSD患者、101名抑郁症患者和100名对照的死后脑组织，发现PTSD患者前额叶皮层四个DNA区域甲基化不同，杏仁核寡突胶质细胞减少；成年创伤供体三个脑区均出现减少，童年创伤供体未呈现同样模式。
articles.limitations: Nature新闻是二手报道，未直接取得Cell Reports论文；研究为死后脑组织横断面比较，不能确立创伤与表观遗传变化的因果关系。

facts.text: 《自然》新闻11月24日报道，一项发表于《细胞报告》的研究分析了创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）和抑郁症患者脑细胞的DNA甲基化。研究纳入101名PTSD患者、101名抑郁症患者和100名无精神疾病对照的死后脑组织与病历。

evidence.quote: The study, published in Cell Reports on 20 November 1 , identifies molecular changes to DNA inside the brain cells of people with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and depression.

The study analysed postmortem brain tissues and medical records donated by 101 people who were diagnosed with PTSD, 101 people with depression and 100 control participants who did not have a mental-health condition.

facts.text: DNA甲基化是在DNA上添加或移除甲基的化学修饰，不改变DNA序列，但可影响基因如何工作。团队检测了杏仁核、海马和前额叶皮层中超过85万个基因组区域的甲基化。

evidence.quote: Epigenetic marks can affect how genes work, but do not alter DNA sequences.
an epigenetic mechanism in which methyl groups are added to or removed from DNA sequences
Champagne and her colleagues examined DNA methylation across more than 850,000 genomic regions in cells taken from three parts of the brain: the amygdala, hippocampus and prefrontal cortex

facts.text: 相比对照组，PTSD患者前额叶皮层有四个DNA区域呈现不同甲基化模式，杏仁核和海马未发现同样差异。

evidence.quote: The study found distinct methylation patterns in four DNA regions in the prefrontal cortex when comparing the PTSD group with the control group, but none in the amygdala or the hippocampus.

facts.text: 细胞层面，PTSD患者杏仁核的寡突胶质细胞显著减少；在58名成年期经历创伤的供体中，三个脑区都出现这种减少，而97名童年期创伤供体未呈现同样模式。

evidence.quote: Compared with the control group, the amygdala in people with PTSD had significantly reduced levels of oligodendrocytes
Oligodendrocytes were reduced across all three brain regions in 58 people who had experienced trauma as adults
The researchers did not observe the same pattern in 97 donors who experienced childhood trauma.

bilingual.title_en: Nature News: Specific DNA methylation differences found in brain tissue of PTSD patients

sentences.en: Nature News reported on November 24 that a study published in Cell Reports analyzed DNA methylation in brain cells from patients with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and depression.
sentences.zh: 《自然》新闻11月24日报道，一项发表于《细胞报告》的研究分析了创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）和抑郁症患者脑细胞的DNA甲基化。

sentences.en: The study included postmortem brain tissue and medical records from 101 patients with PTSD, 101 patients with depression, and 100 controls without psychiatric disorders.
sentences.zh: 研究纳入101名PTSD患者、101名抑郁症患者和100名无精神疾病对照的死后脑组织与病历。

sentences.en: DNA methylation is a chemical modification that adds methyl groups to or removes them from DNA; it does not change the DNA sequence but can affect how genes work.
sentences.zh: DNA甲基化是在DNA上添加或移除甲基的化学修饰，不改变DNA序列，但可影响基因如何工作。

sentences.en: The team examined methylation in more than 850,000 genomic regions in the amygdala, hippocampus, and prefrontal cortex.
sentences.zh: 团队检测了杏仁核、海马和前额叶皮层中超过85万个基因组区域的甲基化。

sentences.en: Compared with the control group, four DNA regions in the prefrontal cortex of PTSD patients showed different methylation patterns, while the same differences were not found in the amygdala or hippocampus.
sentences.zh: 相比对照组，PTSD患者前额叶皮层有四个DNA区域呈现不同甲基化模式，杏仁核和海马未发现同样差异。

sentences.en: At the cellular level, oligodendrocytes in the amygdala of PTSD patients were significantly reduced; among 58 donors who experienced trauma in adulthood, this reduction occurred in all three brain regions, whereas 97 donors with childhood trauma did not show the same pattern.
sentences.zh: 细胞层面，PTSD患者杏仁核的寡突胶质细胞显著减少；在58名成年期经历创伤的供体中，三个脑区都出现这种减少，而97名童年期创伤供体未呈现同样模式。

articles.title: 研究称全球变暖可能中断约2000年前开始的新冰期
articles.summary: ScienceDaily转述哥伦比亚气候学院研究称，加拿大北极Barnes Ice Cap下保存的古植物显示，约2000年前冰盖残余重新扩张，1960年代夏季升温使其转为退缩；研究者认为这可能意味着一次新冰期被全球变暖中断。
articles.new_facts: ScienceDaily 11月24日转述一项发表于Science的研究：Barnes Ice Cap下古植物表明约2000年前冰盖残余重新扩张，1960年代夏季升温使其转为退缩，研究者认为全球变暖可能中断了一次新冰期。
articles.limitations: 结论来自单一冰帽残迹和古植物定年，“下一次冰期已开始”是作者解释，不是全球冰期已发生的直接观测；ScienceDaily为新闻稿转述。

facts.text: ScienceDaily 11月24日转述哥伦比亚气候学院的研究称，约2000年前，加拿大北极一处巨大冰盖的残余开始重新扩张；研究者认为，这可能是地球下一次冰期的开端。

evidence.quote: About 2,000 years ago, the remnants of a massive ice sheet in the Canadian Arctic began expanding once again.
This slow buildup of ice may have marked the beginning of Earth's next glacial period

facts.text: 研究地点是加拿大北极的Barnes Ice Cap。与多数冰川不同，它冻结在基岩上、不在景观上滑动，因此被扩张冰盖掩埋的古植物能原位保存，供放射性碳定年。

evidence.quote: By studying ancient plants preserved beneath the Barnes Ice Cap in the Canadian Arctic, researchers discovered that the remnants of a massive ice sheet began expanding again about 2,000 years ago
Unlike most glaciers, it is frozen directly to the bedrock beneath it and does not slide across the landscape.
As a result, plants that once grew in areas later covered by expanding ice can remain preserved in place for thousands of years.

facts.text: 到1960年代，夏季升温扭转了这一趋势，冰盖转为退缩。研究据此提出，全球变暖可能中断了一次已经启动的新冰期。

evidence.quote: By the 1960s, rising summer temperatures had reversed the trend, causing the ice to retreat instead of grow.
The findings suggest that global warming may have interrupted a new ice age that was already getting underway

bilingual.title_en: Study Says Global Warming May Have Interrupted a New Ice Age That Began About 2,000 Years Ago

sentences.en: ScienceDaily reported on November 24, citing research from Columbia Climate School, that about 2,000 years ago the remnants of a huge ice cap in the Canadian Arctic began to expand again; the researchers believe this may have been the start of Earth's next ice age.
sentences.zh: ScienceDaily 11月24日转述哥伦比亚气候学院的研究称，约2000年前，加拿大北极一处巨大冰盖的残余开始重新扩张；研究者认为，这可能是地球下一次冰期的开端。

sentences.en: The research site is the Barnes Ice Cap in the Canadian Arctic.
sentences.zh: 研究地点是加拿大北极的Barnes Ice Cap。

sentences.en: Unlike most glaciers, it is frozen to the bedrock and does not slide over the landscape, so ancient plants buried by the expanding ice cap can be preserved in place for radiocarbon dating.
sentences.zh: 与多数冰川不同，它冻结在基岩上、不在景观上滑动，因此被扩张冰盖掩埋的古植物能原位保存，供放射性碳定年。

sentences.en: By the 1960s, summer warming had reversed this trend, and the ice cap began to retreat.
sentences.zh: 到1960年代，夏季升温扭转了这一趋势，冰盖转为退缩。

sentences.en: On this basis, the study suggests that global warming may have interrupted a new ice age that had already begun.
sentences.zh: 研究据此提出，全球变暖可能中断了一次已经启动的新冰期。
